package privateconsumer

import (
	"testing"

	scrapekdl "github.com/hsblabs/scrape-kdl"
	rodadapter "github.com/hsblabs/scrape-kdl/adapters/rod"
)

func TestPrivateModuleContractsCompile(t *testing.T) {
	var _ scrapekdl.BrowserAdapter = (*rodadapter.Adapter)(nil)
	if scrapekdl.NewPublicInternetHTTPClient() == nil {
		t.Fatal("NewPublicInternetHTTPClient returned nil")
	}
}
